ns2:section.sectionText: This course introduces learners to a variety of rapid prototyping and fabrication techniques in collaboration with the CU Community Fab Lab. Weekly class lectures will introduce students to practices and pedagogies often found in Makerspaces. During lab sections students will become familiar with common Makerspace tools, such as 3D printers, laser engravers, digital embroidery machines, and small board electronics. The class will have both group and independent work and make use of Canvas for assignment hand-in and peer-feedback. Please note that this course will emphasize self-guided learning and time management. Students will also need to come into Fab Lab open hours outside of their normal lab sections to complete projects. Students who have taken a different Makerspace course at the FabLab previously are eligible to participate in this class, but it is also not a requirement. Graduate students will have an additional documentation project component emphasizing digital literacy.
